verdict.rationale: Reflect is a note-taking app, so shared, collaborative editing is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document sharing a vault or space with collaborators, real-time co-editing, or conflict handling. Read-only public publishing behind a hard-to-guess URL (reflect-docs-9) is an adjacent feature, not collaboration. iCloud/Git sync (reflect-docs-62) and note history with revert (reflect-docs-8) would be user-side workarounds or single-user features. None of these earn credit for this story.
